title: Makhani Gravy
equipment: Dutch oven or heavy bottomed pan with lid
instructions: Heat the oil in a Dutch oven or a large heavy bottomed pan.
Add the onions and garlic and stir until onions are translucent.
Add the tomatoes and cashews. Cover the pan and allow the mixture to cook for 10 minutes for the tomatoes to soften.
Mix in the salt, and add the heavy cream. Stir for about 1 minute.
Add the chili powder, garam masala, kasuri methi, and sugar and stir.
Allow the mixture to sit uncovered for 3-4 minutes before adding the butter.
Add the water and vinegar. Stir once and cover the pan, allow the gravy to cook for 15 minutes.
After the 15 minutes are up, turn off the stove and blend the mixture using a hand blender or food processor.
Add cubed paneer, vegetables or chicken and serve with roti or naan.
